text:
maria: Heads up — canary group for r2026.12 shows 95th token latency +35% starting ~1923456700, coincident with merge 789a2b.
jonathan: saw the CI perf job fail too, perf-ci posted a regression this morning.
perf-ci: nightly/perf: regression detected on master: 95p token latency +30% (compare 1923370000 -> 1923456000). Failing suite: kernel-selection + batching-smoke.
lee: can we get a quick flame/profile? my hunch is kernel selection hinting changed the preferred kernels for small seqs and is causing more lock contention during batching.
srini: also note PR #1423 changed KV cache TTLs (reduced prefix cache lifetime). could be more KV misses + longer tail synthesis. worth checking combined effect.
maria: attaching quick perf snippet from canary host (condensed):
```
# top stacks by CPU
kernel_selector.cpp:selectPreferredKernel 28.1%
batcher.cpp:try_merge 18.5%
kv_cache.cpp:lookup_miss 12.7%
thread_pool.cpp:worker_wait 9.3%
```
jonathan: interesting — selectPreferredKernel spike lines up with batching stalls. batching is waiting on kernel hints before merging requests, so each request serializes longer.
lee: starting bisect now across the merge window (PRs: 1400..1460). will check kernel-hint and batching changes first.
lee: quick update: bisect points to PR #1450 (kernel-hint rework) + PR #1423 (kv-ttl) together reproduce locally. either alone is mild, together big regression.
srini: reproducible combo — increased KV miss amplifies small-seq path, so kernel-selector now chooses a heavier kernel because seq-length heuristics mis-evaluate cached prefix length.
olivia: can we pause the canary rollout? we have an SLO gate but it didn't auto-rollback — borderline.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for r2026.12 at 40% due to perf SLO breach (95p latency > configured threshold).
maria: thanks — propose immediate mitigations: (1) revert kernel-hint change in #1450, (2) restore kv-ttl values from #1423 temporarily, (3) add a short-term guard in kernel-selector to prefer previous kernel for seq<=128.
jonathan: I can open revert PR for #1450 and a follow-up to add the guard. srini can you handle kv-ttl rollback?
srini: will prepare a rollback PR for TTL and a test that simulates high KV miss + small batch pressure.
lee: long-term fix: change batching to not block on kernel hint; use async kernel scoring so merge latency doesn't serialize. add e2e perf test to CI to catch the combo.
olivia: also recommend tightening the canary auto-rollback rule: trigger immediate rollback when 95p delta >20% for 10m, and surface a KV-miss metric to the rollout dashboard.
maria: agreed. action items: jonathan revert #1450, srini revert #1423, lee add async kernel scoring RFC and CI perf test, olivia update canary guard config. I'll track.
jonathan: opened revert PRs and added notes. tagging eng-oncall for potential hotfix rollout.
perf-ci: run triggered for revert PRs. expecting perf pass in next nightly.
lee: will monitor canary after reverting; if stable, proceed with a gradual re-introduction of kernel hint changes behind a flag.
maria: thanks team — good catch on the interaction. continuing to log telemetry to understand root cause better. :thumbsup:
